'''Frédérique Elise Oggier''' is a Swiss mathematician and [[coding theory|coding theorist]] who works as an associate professor of physical and mathematical sciences at [[Nanyang Technological University]] in [[Singapore]].{{r|ntu}}

==Education==
After earning bachelor's and master's degrees in mathematics from the [[University of Geneva]], Oggier completed her doctorate at the [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]],{{r|ntu}} in 2005, under the supervision of [[Eva Bayer-Fluckiger]].{{r|mg}}

==Books==
Oggier is the author of:
*''Lattices applied to coding for reliable and secure communications'' (with Costa, Campello, Belfiore, and Viterbo, Springer, 2017)
*''An introduction to central simple algebras and their applications to wireless communication'' (with Grégory Berhuy, American Mathematical Society, 2013){{r|chapman}}
*''Coding techniques for repairability in networked distributed storage systems'' (with Anwitaman Datta, Now Publishers, 2013)
*''Cyclic division algebras: A tool for space-time coding'' (with Jean-Claude Belfiore and Emanuele Viterbo, Now Publishers, 2007)
*''Algebraic number theory and code design for Rayleigh fading channels'' (with Emanuele Viterbo, Now Publishers, 2004)
